rules.statement: A purchaser at a sale in execution of undivided interests pending partition proceedings is entitled to the share allotted to the judgment debtor, even if the Fiscal's conveyance is for an undivided share.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion, the facts in this case cannot be distinguished from those in Markar v. Siman (supra). I am, therefore, of opinion that the appellant is entitled to the relief which he claims."
